title: Open emoji artwork (Twemoji, Noto, OpenMoji, Fluent)
summary: Choose an emoji artwork set by licence (Twemoji CC-BY, Noto Apache/OFL, OpenMoji BY-SA, Fluent MIT) and credit it correctly.
description: Use when a caption or reaction overlay needs emoji drawn consistently on every platform. Twemoji graphics are CC-BY 4.0, Noto Emoji images Apache-2.0 (fonts OFL), OpenMoji CC BY-SA 4.0 and Microsoft Fluent Emoji MIT. Explains credits, share-alike and trademark limits.

source.notes: Describes https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji (checked 2026-10-10); contains no third-party media.
